purpose: separate credential, HTTP status, capacity, transport and payload failures for the Jev and Ling routes behind the replay-v4 transport_error stop

taxonomy.classification_order: credential check first, then non-2xx HTTP status, then parse failure, then success, then transport failure

definitions.credential_or_configuration_failure: credential missing or malformed, or a local refusal/cap before any request was sent, or a residual non-retryable HTTP status not otherwise classified (the exact sanitized status is retained)
definitions.http_408_5xx_529_provider_capacity: HTTP 408, any 5xx, or HTTP 529 provider capacity
definitions.malformed_response: HTTP success whose body could not be parsed into the expected shape
definitions.timeout_or_network_failure: timeout, DNS, connection or other transport failure with no HTTP status
definitions.valid_response: HTTP success with a parseable response body
